Resources / one free download

Edgeless Free Kit

Templates, field guides, and examples for AI-assisted development. Choose one useful resource and start there. Everything comes together in one download, with a PDF to help you find your way.

Get the free kit

Enter your email on Gumroad to receive the kit. No payment required.

Inside the kit

Start with the CLAUDE.md templates and the Claude Code Cheat Sheet. Explore the rest when you need it. These are reference materials assembled in March–April 2026: check current tool documentation before running scripts or installing hooks.

  • CLAUDE.md Template Pack

    Project instructions you can adapt to your own codebase.

  • Claude Code Cheat Sheet

    A browser-readable command reference.

  • Quick Reference Cards

    Compact references for common development tasks.

  • The Agent Cookbook

    Agent workflow patterns and examples.

  • AI Code Review Playbook

    Checklists and prompts for reviewing changes.

  • Hooks Library

    Hook examples to inspect and adapt.

  • Claude Code Hooks Deep Dive

    A guide to hook design, with example scripts.

  • Obsidian + Claude Code Setup Kit

    Examples for connecting notes with a coding workflow.

  • MCP Server Starter Kit

    Starter code for exploring MCP servers.

  • Production MCP Server Kit

    Server templates and supporting test examples.

  • n8n AI Workflow Templates

    Workflow examples to import into a test instance.

  • Prompt Testing Framework

    Example harnesses for comparing prompt behavior.

  • The Prompt Engineering OS

    The complete team reference edition, included free.

  • Multi-Agent Orchestration Blueprint

    Reference patterns for coordinating agent work.

  • Autonomous Agent Safety Patterns

    Examples of constraints, checks, and safer execution.

  • Generative Art Starter Kit

    Browser sketches and visual experiments.

  • Digital Product Launch Toolkit

    Planning templates and launch checklists.
